entitycustomfield.description: Opt-in for the AR Invoice Sender. When checked, this customer's open invoices are emailed as PDFs to the Email Address for Notification (custentity_2663_email_address_notif), or to the customer's Email when that field is empty.
entitycustomfield.help: Checked by default on new customers. Check to have open invoices emailed automatically. Recipients come from Email Address for Notification (comma- or semicolon-separated list allowed); when that field is empty the customer's Email field is used. Leave unchecked to exclude this customer entirely.
entitycustomfield.label: Auto-Send Open Invoices
